title: Devin Pricing 2026: Free, Pro, Max, Teams and Enterprise | No Code MBA

facts.fact: Devin's Free plan costs $0 per month and includes a light quota, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions.
facts.quote: Free costs $0 and includes a light quota to code with agents, limited model availability, unlimited inline edits and unlimited Tab completions.

facts.fact: Devin's Pro plan costs $20 per month.
facts.quote: Pro costs $20 per month.

facts.fact: Devin's Max plan costs $200 per month and is labeled new on the vendor's pricing page.
facts.quote: Max costs $200 per month and is labeled new.

facts.fact: Devin's Teams plan costs $80 per month for the team plan plus $40 per month for each full dev seat, for up to 200 users.
facts.quote: Teams is $80 per month for the team plan plus $40 per month for each full dev seat, for up to 200 users.

facts.fact: Devin's Enterprise tier is custom priced and is reached through a demo.
facts.quote: Enterprise is custom priced through a demo.

facts.fact: Devin's Enterprise pricing is billed in Agent Compute Units (ACUs).
facts.quote: custom Enterprise pricing billed in Agent Compute Units (ACUs)

facts.fact: In April 2026 Cognition retired the old Core and Team plans, including the $500 per month Team entry point.
facts.quote: In April 2026 Cognition retired the old Core and Team plans, including the $500/month Team entry point.

facts.fact: After the April 2026 change, old Core plan users were moved to the Free plan.
facts.quote: Old Core users moved to Free.

facts.fact: Devin's self-serve plans use included quota plus on-demand usage billed in dollars, while Enterprise stays on ACUs.
facts.quote: Self-serve plans now use included quota plus on-demand usage billed in dollars. Enterprise stays on ACUs.

facts.fact: On Devin's Pro plan, usage beyond the included allowance is billed at API pricing.
facts.quote: If you run out of included usage, you can buy extra usage at API pricing.

facts.fact: Devin's usage allowance on paid plans refreshes automatically on a daily and weekly basis.
facts.quote: Every paid plan includes a usage allowance that refreshes automatically on a daily and weekly basis.

facts.fact: Devin's pricing page states it does not publish a specific number for how much higher Max quotas are than Pro quotas.
facts.quote: Devin does not publish a specific number for how much higher, so treat Max as a purchase for people who consistently exhaust Pro

facts.fact: Devin's comparison table lists concurrent-session limits of up to 10 on the lower plans and unlimited on the top plans.
facts.quote: up to 10 on the lower plans, unlimited on the top ones

facts.fact: Devin's page lists free use of SWE-2 Free in Devin Desktop and the CLI through October 16, 2026, which makes that perk time-limited.
facts.quote: free use of SWE-2 Free in Devin Desktop and the CLI through October 16, 2026

facts.fact: Devin states that most users will not hit their usage limits, and that cost per message depends on the model, task size and complexity, and reasoning required.
facts.quote: Devin says most users will not hit their limits, and that cost per message depends on the model, the size and complexity of the task, and the reasoning required.

facts.fact: Devin lists free use of SWE-2 Free in Devin Desktop and the CLI through October 16, 2026.
facts.quote: Devin lists free use of SWE-2 Free in Devin Desktop and the CLI through October 16, 2026

facts.fact: Devin's Max plan is priced at 200 dollars per month.
facts.quote: only then price Max at 200 dollars per month against measured API-priced overage

facts.fact: Devin's Pro plan costs $20 per month.
facts.quote: Pro is $20/month, Max is $200/month, Teams is $80/month plus $40/month per full dev seat, and Enterprise is custom.

facts.fact: Devin's Teams plan costs $80 per month plus $40 per month per full dev seat.
facts.quote: Teams is $80 per month plus $40 per month per full dev seat, up to 200 users.

facts.fact: Devin's Teams plan with five developers would cost $280 per month before extra usage, according to the page's calculation.
facts.quote: Five developers would be $280 per month before extra usage.

facts.fact: On Devin paid plans, extra usage is consumed at API pricing when limits are hit, rather than hard-blocking.
facts.quote: When limits do hit, extra usage is consumed at API pricing rather than hard-blocking.

facts.fact: Devin paid plan usage allowances refresh automatically on a daily and weekly basis.
facts.quote: Usage allowance on paid plans refreshes automatically on a daily and weekly basis

facts.fact: Devin's Enterprise plan uses Agent Compute Units (ACUs) as its billing unit, while self-serve plans bill overage in dollars.
facts.quote: Agent Compute Units are the billing unit for Devin Enterprise. Self-serve plans bill overage in dollars instead.

facts.fact: Devin says most users will not hit usage limits.
facts.quote: Devin says most users will not hit limits, with per-message cost varying by model, task size and reasoning.
